answer.evidence: The entire signboard is drawn in pure front elevation with straight vertical side contours from row 1 to row 29. The upper section (rows 1-5) features a cyan horizontal display bar centered on a front-facing marquee panel rather than a receding top plane, and the uppermost edge is only a 1px rounded outline (row 0). No foreshortened horizontal top surface is visible.

The top surface of the signboard structure is clearly rendered from rows 1 to 5 (5 pixels tall) with its own depth and detailing, separated by a distinct edge line at row 6 from the illuminated front face below (rows 7-29).

The main signboard body (rows 6-30) is drawn in pure front elevation with a 1px flat black line at the top. The inset structure on top (rows 1-5) is narrower than the main body and is also rendered as a front-facing panel with a cyan bar rather than a foreshortened top surface.

The top horizontal surface of the standing sign board is rendered with a depth of 5 pixel rows (rows 1–5), clearly visible from the elevated 3/4 camera view above the front-facing neon display (rows 6–30).
